page.overview:
What is Guanhao?

Guanhao is an island in Paradise where the World Government organized a training camp for future Cipher Pol agents.

The island is covered by a forest. The only known building on the island is a high tower with trees on a roof.

The World Government uses Guanhao as a training camp for future Cipher Pol generations. Rob Lucci and other CP9 members had trained on the island until they became strong enough to become full-fledged agents.

Lucci and other CP9 members returned to Guanhao after recovering in St. Poplar. Very Good pursued them but he was easily defeated.
